items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: when I had the saxophone studio, I rented out to the saxophone studio to Ruth Bowen to do publicity.

ctx.x: Well, that's what I want to know. Tell me about it.

Well, I was a good friend... See, I kind of halfway gave... I didn't give her a start, but when I had the saxophone studio, I rented out to the saxophone studio to Ruth Bowen to do publicity. I talked her into being a personal for Dinah. Because I told her, "it's a possibility that Dinah needs somebody with a little class" -- because Dinah didn't have no class. She'd cuss somebody out. I remember she played in Chicago, and the man said she did a wonderful business to the end of the week, and when she closed, she…
